title: Docs-hygiene team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml, the team layer of the docs-hygiene plugin's settings. A key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Keys and resolution: plugins/docs-hygiene/reference/config.md.

written_against.description: The plugin version the setup writer last wrote this file against, as <plugin>@<version>. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

provenance.description: Per setting, whether the team chose the value or it was filled at the plugin default. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

compress_articles.description: Whether /docs-hygiene:compress removes a, an and the. keep: articles stay, and compression runs on the in-session Edit backend with word-level cuts only. cut: articles may be removed, and the caveman backend runs when installed.

compress_revert_below_pct.description: Percent compression below which /docs-hygiene:compress reverts a result with zero semantic loss. 0 turns the auto-revert off; --force bypasses it on one run.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example compress); an entry beats this file's verification value.
